metadata.article_title: Preservation and retention of information by intermediaries.

article.title: Preservation and retention of information by intermediaries.
article.content:
(1) Intermediary shall preserve and retain such information as may be specified for such duration and in such manner and format as the Central Government may prescribe.
(2) any intermediary who intentionally or knowingly contravenes the provisions of sub-section (1) shall be 1[liable to penalty which may extend to twenty-five lakh rupees].]
Note: the final bracket closes the substitution of sections 66 to 67C made by Act 10 of 2009, s. 32.
article.html:
67CPreservation and retention of information by intermediaries.

Section 67C · Chapter XI · page 26 of the Act

(1) Intermediary shall preserve and retain such information as may be specified for such duration and in such manner and format as the Central Government may prescribe.

(2) any intermediary who intentionally or knowingly contravenes the provisions of sub-section (1) shall be 1[liable to penalty which may extend to twenty-five lakh rupees].]

Note: the final bracket closes the substitution of sections 66 to 67C made by Act 10 of 2009, s. 32.

1 Subs. by Act 18 of 2023, s. 2 and Schedule for certain words (w.e.f. 30-11-2023).
